description: Close the named app, or close the active session app when app is omitted. The shutdown option also stops the session simulator or emulator where supported; close alone never stops the device. Android ADB close fails with android-app-close-timeout if the app stays foreground past 2s or a killed process does not exit within 10s; a new process that Android starts afterwards does not fail it. It fails with android-process-probe-unavailable when adb pidof cannot list the app processes; if that happens before the force-stop, the app keeps running. If close cannot confirm its cleanup on a session that holds a device claim, the session and its claim stay. A repeated close retries cleanup with the same options, except that save-script must be omitted after publication. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

force.description: Overwrite an existing --save-script target instead of refusing (alias: --overwrite).

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

name: close
title: Close an app or end the session
